context:
Goal: a home session stops only where it should, including before an HA restart.
Problem (rule): after 229 a, home CLAUDE.md line 46 reads "Stop only for a decision that is the owner's, or a test only the owner can run". That is a closed list, and it no longer names line 11's wait (before an HA restart, wait for a live HA session or ask you). No check holds that wait.
Based on (ruling): 229 a (22:30 CST) named this cut.
Departs from: home #550's line 46 — b adds "or a wait or hold this file names".

options.how: No change; line 11 stands on its own.
options.label: Keep it as ruled
options.lose: A session reading only line 46 may skip the HA wait.

options.how: A follow-up lane adds "or a wait or hold this file names" to line 46.
options.label: Add the clause

short: home: stop list and HA wait
title: home: after 229 a, the stop list leaves out the wait before an HA restart. Add it back?
why: Recommended: a. Line 11 stands on its own, and your ruling named this exact cut. Meanwhile #550 goes on in its batch.
